meta.name: facebook-ads-library-search
meta.description: Searches Meta Ad Library (Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp ads) by keyword or Facebook page ID and extracts ad details including creatives, copy, CTA, publisher platforms, spend, impressions, reach estimates, and page transparency info. Use when user mentions Meta Ad Library, Facebook ads scraper, Instagram ads data, FB ad library, search Facebook ads, get ads from a Facebook page, scrape Meta ads, Facebook advertising data, ad creative extraction, competitor ads analysis, brand ads monitoring, Meta advertising transparency, political ads Facebook, housing ads Facebook, view all ads from a page, facebook ads search, fb ads library api, facebook ad archive, instagram ad data, get ad creatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并提取Meta广告库中的广告详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从Meta广告库获取竞争对手或品牌的广告数据。
copy.tagline_en: Search and extract ad details from Meta Ad Library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to get ad data from Meta Ad Library for competitive or brand analysis.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以按关键词或 Facebook 主页 ID 搜索 Meta 广告库，返回广告的文案、图片、视频、CTA、投放平台、花费估算等信息。
howto.when: 当你提到“Meta 广告库”、“Facebook 广告搜索”、“查看某主页的广告”或要求分析竞品广告时触发。

say.text: 搜索关键词“运动鞋”的当前活跃广告。
say.note: 返回广告列表，包含文案和素材。

say.text: 查看 Nike 主页（ID: 15087023444）的所有广告。
say.note: 返回该主页投放的广告详情。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the Meta Ad Library by keyword or Facebook page ID, returning ad details including creatives, copy, CTA, publisher platforms, spend estimates, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Meta Ad Library", "Facebook ads search", "view ads from a page", or ask for competitor ad analysis.

say_en.text: Search for active ads with keyword "sneakers".
say_en.note: Returns ad list with copy and creatives.

say_en.text: Get all ads from Nike page (ID: 15087023444).
say_en.note: Returns ads details for that page.
